speaker: margery_pell
text: 'Prentices let off for the fair, their masters after them to see where they went, and not one lawyer. Fifty-two shillings in mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fifty-two, and the yard full by the second trumpet. I smelled the paint before I smelled the people.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou walkedst on as if the month had been a pause in the middle of a line. Three years, Will. The oath had a new length in thy mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard it. Three years, and no woman, and one meal, and I have just come from a fair. The paint is still new on the posts. The oath does not know we were dark.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A month, stored. I have been putting laughs by in a dry barrel, and Costard spent them. You will find the interest in the book, if the book is still in one piece.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Fourteen. One scene. I ticked them, and the pen died on the fourteenth. I am not angry. I am out of a pen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen in one scene is a month speaking at once. The pen agreed, and broke. You will have another pen. The fourteen can stay where you ticked them. I am not tearing a reopening.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You and I are still on you, and I will stay there. The yard laughed where I spent the month, and that is the receipt I came for. Not yours. Theirs.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. The half-wages have held. All five answered the plot. I had a fear of an empty name, and I did not get one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the fear can sit down. What do they go back to?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Ten shillings. The half is done. Five shillings was August, and August is open again. Item: Raye may bank on both sides of the water. I have told him so, in those words, and I would like them said where he can hear them a second time.

speaker: hired_men
text: I heard them the first time. Both sides. I will not make a speech of it. I was here for the five. I am here for the ten.

speaker: john_heminges
text: That is the speech. It is short enough to enter. The other four are below, changing, and they answered when the plot called them. I am not going to praise a man for being where he was paid to be. I am going to pay him.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Pay him, John. The house laughed, the gallery has fifty-two shillings in it, and I am still in the oath up to my neck. Thou, Will, said three years as if thou meantst them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I meant the part. The part has been dark since July. It came out with paint on it. That is all the meaning I will own tonight.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book is ruled. The fourteen are in the margin, and the margin can live. I want a pen before Saturday, and I want no one to call the broken one a sign.

speaker: will_kemp
text: It is a sign. A pen dies of me. I have waited a month to be a sign, and I will take a small one.

speaker: margery_pell
text: My sign is fifty-two, and not one lawyer among them. Lawyers stay in term. Prentices do not. If the Rose had the lawyers, they are welcome to them. I had the boys and their masters, and the masters were looking for the boys, which is a full stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the fifty-two. I am not asking you what the other house took. I walked on. The oath is said. John has his five. Will has his fourteen, and his pen.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot was answered. I called five names and five men came. That is my good news. The pen is the other, and it can be bought.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Call the fourteen interest, and not a corpse. I had a laugh at two of the clock, and the yard paid me in the only coin I trust.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You did. The fourteen stand. I came on in the smell of fresh paint, the heavens blue over the door, and the oath was simply the oath.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, then, and I am done. Ten shillings, five men, the half ruled off. I will write the wages where I write wages. Saturday is the sharers' week, and it is not this conversation.

speaker: hired_men
text: Saturday can tell us. I know what I am, until then. Both sides. You said it, Master Heminges. He said it again. That is enough for a Monday.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go home, all of you who have homes that will let you up the stair. Will. Tomorrow is the same hour. Keep the back as far as the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: As far as the door. Tomorrow is the same hour and another play. I am not conning anything tonight that I conned in the yard.
